definitions.gloss: lost dog; stray dog that has wandered away from its owner
definitions.explanation: A pet dog that has become separated from its owner and is wandering. Distinguished from a permanently stray or feral dog — a 迷い犬 has an owner somewhere.

examples.japanese: {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}を{保護|ほご}した。
examples.english: I took in a lost dog.

examples.japanese: {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}の{情報|じょうほう}を{掲示板|けいじばん}に{載|の}せた。
examples.english: I posted information about a lost dog on the bulletin board.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}で{迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}を{見|み}かけたので、{交番|こうばん}に{届|とど}けた。
examples.english: I spotted a lost dog in the neighborhood, so I reported it at the police box.

examples.japanese: SNSで{迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}の{写真|しゃしん}を{拡散|かくさん}したら、{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: After sharing the lost dog's photo on social media, the owner was found.

notes:
Composed of {迷|まよ}い (wandering, lost — the continuative form of {迷|まよ}う) and {犬|いぬ} (dog). The {迷|まよ}い～ pattern creates compounds meaning 'lost/stray ~': {迷|まよ}い{猫|ねこ} (lost cat), {迷|まよ}い{子|こ} (lost child).

In Japan, if you find a {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}, you can take it to the nearest {交番|こうばん} (police box) or contact the local {動物愛護|どうぶつあいご}センター (animal welfare center). Many municipalities now also use social media and dedicated websites to reunite lost pets with their owners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}を{保護|ほご}する: to take in/shelter a lost dog
- {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}の{届|とど}け: lost dog report
- {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}の{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}: the owner of a lost dog
- {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}を{見|み}かける: to spot a lost dog

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {野良犬|のらいぬ}: stray dog — a dog without an owner, living on its own permanently
- {迷|まよ}い{猫|ねこ}: lost cat — the feline equivalent
- {迷|まよ}い{子|こ}: lost child — a child who has become separated from their parent or guardian
